Hello,

I wondered if PLASQ500K should be included on this list? (with regard
to this page - http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/external-resources)

Laframboise T, Harrington D, Weir BA.
PLASQ: a generalized linear model-based procedure to determine allelic
dosage in cancer cells from SNP array data.
Biostatistics. 2007 Apr;8(2):323-36. Epub 2006 Jun 20.
URL: http://genome.dfci.harvard.edu/~tlaframb/PLASQ/

cheers

Lavinia.
